knowledge_entries.title: Multi-Layer Impact Synthesis
knowledge_entries.description: Combining high-frequency whoosh, mid-frequency mechanical click, and sub-80Hz bass drop to create immense weight.
knowledge_entries.when_to_use: Use on beat drops, logo reveals, and dramatic smash cuts.
knowledge_entries.notes: Always low-pass filter background music by 6dB during the impact hit.

knowledge_entries.title: 3D Camera Projection Mapping
knowledge_entries.description: Projecting 2D photography onto 3D geometry to create parallax motion from still images.
knowledge_entries.when_to_use: Use when client gives low-resolution still photos and wants dynamic video movement.
knowledge_entries.notes: Use CC Power Pin and 3D null controller for realistic focal blur.
